name: dsh-session-title-context
description: Cordis plugin: full-context session-title provider that gets the title back through a tool call (reasoning-model safe), strips images, and can be re-run with a one-off model.

dsh.description: 会话标题生成：完整上下文（去图片）、工具调用取标题（兼容推理模型）、默认当前会话模型并支持 /title 一次性指定模型；会话标题栏右侧带「标题」控件（client 半边）
